codexPinned.rule: Rendered as Pinned, not as a user-created Project; it accepts Thread moves but cannot be renamed or deleted.

codexChat.search: thread/list searchTerm over extracted title in the stable baseline
codexChat.standalone: section is null and the Chat appears in Recents

vibehubProject.mappingToCodexProject: optional explicit association; never name equality

vibehubTask.chatAssociation: zero or many Codex Threads; one immutable origin locator when born from Chat

taskOrigin.identity: one immutable locator per born Task
locator: exact Turn id or selected Turn range
taskOrigin.cardinality: one continuous Chat may birth zero or many independent Tasks
taskOrigin.mutationRule: moving, renaming, forking or continuing the Chat never moves or rewrites the Task

taskRun.rule: Run completion is not VibeHub Outcome acceptance

uiSemantics.Pinned: the built-in immutable Codex ThreadSection is rendered separately from Projects
uiSemantics.Recents: non-archived Threads returned by thread/list with sectionId explicitly null
uiSemantics.move: thread/section/move changes only Thread.section and ordering
uiSemantics.fork: thread/fork creates a new Thread with forkedFromId; the VibeHub adapter then places it in the source section by default and reports a visible unsectioned-Recents fallback if placement fails
uiSemantics.deleteProject: threadSection/delete atomically returns member Threads to unsectioned Recents
uiSemantics.search: all-section native Thread query; Task and Context search remain separately typed

invariants: Codex app-server is the sole transcript and Project-membership authority.
No browser localStorage, IndexedDB or second chat registry stores membership.
Codex Project movement never changes Thread.cwd.
Codex Project movement never changes VibeHub Project, Task, Context, Evidence or Outcome.
A Chat fork is a Thread lineage edge, not a Subtask or Task dependency.
Task origin is provenance, not Codex Project membership.

migrationAndFailure.nativeAvailability: Pinned Codex 0.147.0 satisfies every required Project-membership method, so no shadow membership store is created.
migrationAndFailure.schemaDrift: The adapter stops when a required method or pinned schema hash is missing.
migrationAndFailure.forkPlacementRace: If the source Project disappears after fork creation, the new native Thread remains visible in unsectioned Recents with forkedFromId and the adapter reports placement.applied=false.
migrationAndFailure.upgrade: Re-probe generated schema and live lifecycle before accepting a new Codex baseline; server-owned identities require no VibeHub migration.
migrationAndFailure.removal: Removing VibeHub removes no Codex Project or Thread data because VibeHub stores no membership copy.
